描述_EN: very quickly the artisans realised the decorative potentials of this material. lacquer is a waterproof varnish made from the sap of the tree rhus vernicifera. multiple layers of lacquer were piled on the surface of the vessel and decorative patterns were carved on the lacquer. in this example a peony is shown on the lid. the chinese began to use it to provide a protective coating to wooden and bamboo bowls at least 3,000 years ago.
描述_ZN: 年，工匠们很快意识到了这种材料的装饰潜力。 漆是一种防水的清漆，是由树的汁液制成的，它是由Rhus vernicifera制成的。 在器皿的表面堆积多层漆，并在漆上雕刻装饰图案。 在这个例子中，盖子上有一朵牡丹。 中国人至少在3000年前就开始用它来为木碗和竹碗提供保护层。
